operations.body:
"the user must go to the card detail page" - The user can't edit Wants from the Card Detail page, the Card Details carry no way to edit Wants, only the Catalog grid/list view currently allows this.
I think "A want that is exactly met (desired == present) collapses to '—' in the WANTED cell" is the wrong UI choice, instead a "0" should render along with the stepper.
